g.text: Construction authorized; SEL HIGH closes S <-> D, LOW opens.

g.desc: Construction authorized; SEL HIGH closes S <-> D, LOW opens.

g.text: RAIL TELEMETRY — four switched, filtered ADC development channels

g.desc: RAIL TELEMETRY — four switched, filtered ADC development channels

g.text: Telemetry is NOT autonomous protection. 10nF C0G filters are BEFORE the switch.

g.desc: Telemetry is NOT autonomous protection. 10nF C0G filters are BEFORE the switch.

g.text: The47k ADC bleeds load each divider; use calculated loaded gains.

g.desc: The47k ADC bleeds load each divider; use calculated loaded gains.

g.text: Ioff +/-2uA atVDD=0 is not a floating/brownout bound.

g.desc: Ioff +/-2uA atVDD=0 is not a floating/brownout bound.

g.text: Dedicated qualifier; no shared SWD control or MCU permission.

g.desc: Dedicated qualifier; no shared SWD control or MCU permission.

g.text: PA0/PA1/PA4/PA5: analog mode, no pulls. Start10Hz scan.

g.desc: PA0/PA1/PA4/PA5: analog mode, no pulls. Start10Hz scan.

g.text: Honor ADC regulator/reference startup; rearm after >100us idle.

g.desc: Honor ADC regulator/reference startup; rearm after >100us idle.

g.text: Discard first conversion after channel changes; wait >=2ms

g.desc: Discard first conversion after channel changes; wait >=2ms

g.text: following switch qualification or large rail transition.

g.desc: following switch qualification or large rail transition.

g.text: DEVELOPMENT: SYS/BATT <=60V, protected5V <=6V, essential3V3 <=3.6V are imposed ceilings, NOT arbitrary-fault survival.
